hints.title: Tracking Last Chosen Character
hints.text: A good palindrome has even length and no two adjacent matching characters. Record the last matched outer character.

hints.title: Boundary Matching Transition
hints.text: For substring s[i..j], if s[i] == s[j] and s[i] does not match prev, we can match this pair and transition to dp(i + 1, j - 1, s[i]) + 2.

hints.title: Non-Matching Boundary Contraction
hints.text: Otherwise, take the maximum of skipping the left character dp(i + 1, j, prev) and skipping the right character dp(i, j - 1, prev).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Memorizes states over left boundary, right boundary, and previous character.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subsequences is exponential O(2^N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Interval DP with state augmentation resolves distinct-neighbor constraint in polynomial time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Augmented state dynamic programming memoizing last picked character.

solutions.approach: Augmented State Interval DP with Memoization
